q: Chemistry is a study of _____ and the changes it undergoes.
e: Chemistry is a study of matter and the changes it undergoes. Chemistry studies matter and the changes matter undergoes. Elements would fill a different blank than matter.

q: Matter is anything that has mass and _____ .
e: Matter is anything that has mass and occupies space. Occupies space is the idea that completes this fact. Conducts electricity would fill a different blank than occupies space.

q: Chemistry is often referred to as the _____ .
e: Chemistry is often referred to as the Central Science. Chemistry is called the central science because it links physics to biology and to materials. Core Discipline would fill a different blank than Central Science.

q: Which of the following activities involves practicing chemistry?
e: Cooking in the kitchen involves practicing chemistry. Cooking changes substances in food, so it is everyday chemistry. Watching television does not involve practicing chemistry.

q: Our body combines oxygen from the air with part of the food we eat to provide us with _____ .
e: Our body combines oxygen from the air with part of the food we eat to provide us with energy. Your body uses oxygen from air with food to release energy. Nutrients would fill a different blank than energy.

q: Chemistry deals with matter ranging from the tiniest parts of atoms to the complex _____ .
e: Chemistry deals with matter ranging from the tiniest parts of atoms to the complex human body. Human body is the idea that completes this fact. Ecosystem would fill a different blank than human body.

q: Which societal issue is addressed using principles of chemistry?
e: Climate change is societal issue is addressed using principles of chemistry. Climate change is a long-term shift in weather patterns, driven strongly by greenhouse gases. Language barriers is a different claim from climate change.

q: Faster electronic devices and stronger plastics rely on innovations from _____ .
e: Faster electronic devices and stronger plastics rely on innovations from chemists. Chemists is the idea that completes this fact. Engineers would fill a different blank than chemists.

q: The period from prehistoric times to about 300 BC is classified as the _____ .
e: The period from prehistoric times to about 300 BC is classified as the black magic period. Black magic period is the idea that completes this fact. Alchemy era would fill a different blank than black magic period.

q: The ancient Greeks believed the world was made of four elements: earth, air, water, and _____ .
e: The ancient Greeks believed the world was made of four elements: earth, air, water, and fire. Fire is the idea that completes this fact. Metal would fill a different blank than fire.

q: Greek philosophers like Aristotle explained the behaviour of matter using _____ rather than experimentation.
e: Greek philosophers like Aristotle explained the behaviour of matter using philosophic reasoning rather than experimentation. Philosophic reasoning is the idea that completes this fact. Mathematical models would fill a different blank than philosophic reasoning.

q: Which technique was developed by alchemists and is still used today?
e: Distillation is technique was developed by alchemists and is still used today. Distillation separates liquids by boiling point, then condenses the vapour. Chromatography is a different claim from distillation.

q: Robert Boyle developed basic ideas about the behaviour of _____ .
e: Robert Boyle developed basic ideas about the behaviour of gases. Gases is the idea that completes this fact. Liquids would fill a different blank than gases.

q: Joseph Priestley discovered a gas later named _____ .
e: Joseph Priestley discovered a gas later named oxygen. Priestley's 1774 work is the isolation of oxygen gas. Nitrogen would fill a different blank than oxygen.

q: Antoine Lavoisier explained the law of conservation of _____ based on experimentation.
e: Antoine Lavoisier explained the law of conservation of matter based on experimentation. Matter is the idea that completes this fact. Mass would fill a different blank than matter.

q: John Dalton postulated the _____ Theory.
e: John Dalton postulated the Atomic Theory. Atomic is the idea that completes this fact. Quantum would fill a different blank than Atomic.

q: Amedeo Avogadro laid the groundwork for a more quantitative approach to chemistry by calculating the number of particles in a given amount of a _____ .
e: Amedeo Avogadro laid the groundwork for a more quantitative approach to chemistry by calculating the number of particles in a given amount of a gas. In a gas, particles are far apart, move fast, and have weak attractions. Solid would fill a different blank than gas.

q: Modern chemistry began in the _____ .
e: Modern chemistry began in the middle of 19th century. Middle of 19th century is the idea that completes this fact. Early 20th century would fill a different blank than middle of 19th century.

q: Which of the following is NOT listed as an important area in modern chemistry?
e: Astrochemistry is the option that does not belong with the rest. Astrochemistry is the idea that completes this fact. Green chemistry is among the listed items, so it is not the exception.

q: Scientific facts in chemistry are verified by _____ .
e: Scientific facts in chemistry are verified by repeated testing. Repeated testing is the idea that completes this fact. Philosophical debate would fill a different blank than repeated testing.

q: Everything you do involves _____ .
e: Everything you do involves chemistry. Chemistry is the idea that completes this fact. Physics would fill a different blank than chemistry.

q: The air you breathe is a mixture of oxygen, _____ , and other gases.
e: The air you breathe is a mixture of oxygen, nitrogen, and other gases. Nitrogen is the idea that completes this fact. Argon would fill a different blank than nitrogen.

q: Clothes made from nylon or terylene are composed of synthetic chemicals called _____ .
e: Clothes made from nylon or terylene are composed of synthetic chemicals called polymers. Polymers is the idea that completes this fact. Metals would fill a different blank than polymers.

q: The book you are reading is made from wood pulp or cellulose treated with various _____ .
e: The book you are reading is made from wood pulp or cellulose treated with various chemicals. Chemicals is the idea that completes this fact. Dyes would fill a different blank than chemicals.

q: Seat padding made of polyurethane is an example of a _____ .
e: Seat padding made of polyurethane is an example of a plastic polymer. Plastic polymer is the idea that completes this fact. Metal alloy would fill a different blank than plastic polymer.

q: Cement, concrete, and glass are all examples of _____ .
e: Cement, concrete, and glass are all examples of chemicals. Making glass from sand and alkali is an early industrial chemical change. Minerals would fill a different blank than chemicals.

q: A better understanding of chemistry helps us maximise benefits and minimise _____ in chemical use.
e: A better understanding of chemistry helps us maximise benefits and minimise risk in chemical use. Risk is the idea that completes this fact. Complexity would fill a different blank than risk.

q: Organic chemistry focuses on most carbon-containing chemicals which are hydrocarbons and their _____ .
e: Organic chemistry focuses on most carbon-containing chemicals which are hydrocarbons and their derivatives. Organic chemistry studies carbon compounds, especially hydrocarbons and their derivatives. Isotopes would fill a different blank than derivatives.

q: Inorganic chemistry generally deals with matter that does not involve _____ .
e: Inorganic chemistry generally deals with matter that does not involve hydrocarbons. A hydrocarbon contains only hydrogen and carbon. Metals is among the listed items, so it is not the exception.

q: Physical chemistry studies the behaviour and changes of matter and the related _____ changes.
e: Physical chemistry studies the behaviour and changes of matter and the related energy changes. Energy is the idea that completes this fact. Phase would fill a different blank than energy.

q: Analytical chemistry is concerned with the components and _____ of substances.
e: Analytical chemistry is concerned with the components and compositions of substances. Compositions is the idea that completes this fact. Structures would fill a different blank than compositions.

q: Biochemistry studies matter and processes of _____ organisms.
e: Biochemistry studies matter and processes of living organisms. Living is the idea that completes this fact. Aquatic would fill a different blank than living.

q: Which branch of chemistry includes the study of metabolism and fermentation?
e: Biochemistry is branch of chemistry includes the study of metabolism and fermentation. Biochemistry is the chemistry of living organisms and their processes. Physical chemistry is a different claim from biochemistry.

q: Pharmaceuticals and plastics are examples studied in _____ chemistry.
e: Pharmaceuticals and plastics are examples studied in organic chemistry. Organic chemistry studies carbon compounds, especially hydrocarbons and their derivatives. Analytical would fill a different blank than organic.

q: Minerals, metals, and semiconductors fall under _____ chemistry.
e: Minerals, metals, and semiconductors fall under inorganic chemistry. Inorganic chemistry studies the rest of the elements and their compounds, not just hydrocarbons. Organic would fill a different blank than inorganic.

q: Reaction rates and mechanisms are studied in _____ chemistry.
e: Reaction rates and mechanisms are studied in physical chemistry. Physical chemistry looks at how matter and energy behave in chemical systems. Analytical would fill a different blank than physical.

q: Quality control (QC) and quality assurance (QA) are applications of _____ chemistry.
e: Quality control (QC) and quality assurance (QA) are applications of analytical chemistry. Analytical chemistry finds what is in a sample and how much is there. Green would fill a different blank than analytical.

q: Which of the following is NOT one of the five main branches of chemistry?
e: Environmental chemistry is the option that does not belong with the rest. Environmental chemistry is the idea that completes this fact. Analytical chemistry is among the listed items, so it is not the exception.

q: Nanochemistry is considered a(n) _____ branch of chemistry.
e: Nanochemistry is considered a(n) additional branch of chemistry. Additional is the idea that completes this fact. Main would fill a different blank than additional.

q: Studying chemistry helps you become a global citizen who acts with greater _____ in a complex civilisation.
e: Studying chemistry helps you become a global citizen who acts with greater understanding in a complex civilisation. Understanding is the idea that completes this fact. Speed would fill a different blank than understanding.

q: The properties of drugs, foods, and the human brain cell are determined mainly by _____ principles.
e: The properties of drugs, foods, and the human brain cell are determined mainly by chemical principles. A chemical property describes how a substance reacts to make something new. Physical would fill a different blank than chemical.

q: Chemistry is very important for the food and beverage industry and the _____ industry.
e: Chemistry is very important for the food and beverage industry and the medical industry. Medical is the idea that completes this fact. Transportation would fill a different blank than medical.

q: Industries manufacturing soaps, detergents, dyes, and polymers contribute significantly to a nation’s _____ .
e: Industries manufacturing soaps, detergents, dyes, and polymers contribute significantly to a nation’s economy. Economy is the idea that completes this fact. Education system would fill a different blank than economy.

q: Courses in Pharmacy and Medicine require applicants to have knowledge of _____ .
e: Courses in Pharmacy and Medicine require applicants to have knowledge of chemistry. Chemistry is the idea that completes this fact. Literature would fill a different blank than chemistry.

q: Cutting-edge digital technology requires knowledge of the principles of _____ .
e: Cutting-edge digital technology requires knowledge of the principles of chemistry. Chemistry is the idea that completes this fact. Linguistics would fill a different blank than chemistry.

q: Basic chemistry helps make your material world more _____ .
e: Basic chemistry helps make your material world more meaningful. Meaningful is the idea that completes this fact. Expensive would fill a different blank than meaningful.

q: Chemistry is considered an experimental science because its laws result from extensive _____ .
e: Chemistry is considered an experimental science because its laws result from extensive observations. Observations is the idea that completes this fact. Calculations would fill a different blank than observations.

q: Which skill is developed through studying chemistry?
e: Measuring is skill is developed through studying chemistry. Measuring is the idea that completes this fact. Memorizing poetry is a different claim from measuring.

q: Basic chemistry studies the preparation, properties, structures and _____ of material substances.
e: Basic chemistry studies the preparation, properties, structures and reactions of material substances. Reactions is the idea that completes this fact. Colors would fill a different blank than reactions.

q: Myanmar, as a developing country, needs talented and _____ chemists.
e: Myanmar, as a developing country, needs talented and creative chemists. Creative is the idea that completes this fact. Famous would fill a different blank than creative.

q: Which of the following is NOT one of the six main themes in Basic Education High School Chemistry?
e: Thermodynamics is the option that does not belong with the rest. Thermodynamics is the idea that completes this fact. Organic chemistry is among the listed items, so it is not the exception.

q: Knowledge of chemistry principles helps students make intelligent decisions about benefits and _____ to mankind.
e: Knowledge of chemistry principles helps students make intelligent decisions about benefits and hazards to mankind. Hazards is the idea that completes this fact. Festivals would fill a different blank than hazards.

q: The course 'Chemistry Grade 10' will become a beneficial _____ in your career.
e: The course 'Chemistry Grade 10' will become a beneficial asset in your career. Asset is the idea that completes this fact. Obstacle would fill a different blank than asset.
